pkgs.label: REST (sit down to heal and lower fatigue)
pkgs.fix: From review r2 (pass, 2 minors; blind A/B 5-0) and the orchestrator's look at the shots. Owner: 'resting should sit you down'. (1) Pose: on open ground the held sleep_down frame reads as reclined with knees up, like a knockdown, from the game's iso camera; hold one clearly upright seated frame (torso up, hands on knees or ground beside the hips) for every place - pick the frame from the clip by measuring torso pitch, or blend sleep_down with idle's upper body - and check it in the iso camera at 1600x900 and 844x390 next to a knocked-down survivor so the two never look alike; (2) hide or lift the 'Survivor' nameplate while seated so it never sits on the torso; (3) restyle the rest chip as a status pill in the HUD's family (icon + 'Resting by the fire' + rates), readable at 844x390 (>= 11 px text), and keep it clear of other HUD blocks; (4) recovery feedback at the character (owner: 'make it flashy', no glitchy motion): small green +HP ticks that rise and fade and a soft warm glow by the fire, smooth, no jumps; (5) roll or attack while seated stands her up with the stand-up clip (test it). Re-shoot open, fire, tent and phone cases and look at them; record the motion gate.

pkgs.label: SAILUI
pkgs.fix: From review r2 (pass, 5 minors) and the blind A/B judge (won 4-0): (1) scroll the sea only for one finger: ignore ScreenDrag events whose index is not the lowest active touch, so a two-finger pan or pinch does not move the chart (add a two-finger case to t_sailui); (2) size the sea's 2x minimum from the full canvas width, not the safe view, and clamp the island card's height to the sea view so it never runs past it with phone safe-area insets (add a non-zero-inset case via a safe_rect override); (3) the red 'Survival N' requirement under locked nodes gets a dark pill or stronger contrast so it reads on teal at 844x390 (~11 px text); (4) when no island is sailable (e.g. Survival 0), show a one-line hint such as 'Reach Survival 10 to sail' near the header; (5) make it obvious the chart scrolls past the right edge (a fade plus a chevron at the right edge while more chart lies beyond); (6) keep the drifting clouds below the band headings and node labels (draw order or keep-out zones), and at compact sizes start the top node of a two-island band a few px lower so 'Lv. 25' no longer touches its ripple ring; (7) t_sailui: assert the exact lock edge (survival == route level unlocks, stones == fare enables); (8) the report says 22 test files: say 23. Re-shoot 1600x900 (both renderers) and 844x390, home/savannah/right/card, and look at them.

pkgs.label: DEINO (Deinonychus v2)
pkgs.fix: From review r1 (pass, 5 minors; blind A/B 7-0): (1) real_length_m is 10.2 but the v2 mesh is 8.10 m long; creature_plates.gd places the plate at real_length_m*0.5 ahead of centre, past the snout. Set real_length_m in game/data/creatures/deinonychus.json to the measured v2 length (8.1) unless other systems need 10.2 (grep every reader; the creature's visual size must not change); (2) W2-RAGDOLL (finish-6, may merge first or second) has a deinonychus profile naming v1 bones (FrontFoot, BackLowLeg, Body, Shoulders, Neck, Tail2-5): if W2-RAGDOLL is already on claude/mmo-overhaul when you sync, refit that profile to the v2 bone names in this branch (test a death ragdoll in creature lab); otherwise leave the re-tune list in the report for W2-RAGDOLL's integrator; (3) add attack_heavy's worst-frame skin-stretch number to the report. Re-run creature-verify, creature_anim_lab and the side/iso shots and look at them.

pkgs.label: NET (network core)
pkgs.fix: From review r1 (pass, 7 minors). Fix these NET-side ones: (1) net_server.gd _handle: auth.hello after sign-in must go through _strike (bad_request 'already signed in on this connection'), and a burst closes the socket with 4005 - test it; (2) handler-class rate_limited answers (e.g. chat.send over its bucket) must not count as flood strikes; keep strikes for malformed or unthrottled frames, so a player mashing Send is throttled, not disconnected - test it; (3) MAX_PER_IP becomes a rules.json/server-flag value defaulting to at least max_players_area (30), documented in the runbook - test 24 clients from one IP all get online; (4) net_characters.gd: call _sync_position only for mutating act.* ops, not for char.get, so reads write no journal lines - test it. Leave for later and list in the report: the first-visit position check (a hard prerequisite for W3-SRVWORLD/W3-SRVACT), the chat backlog/System channel and wide-glyph width (CHAT's package). Rerun net_tests, tools/net_smoke.sh, every t_*.gd, run_all and smoke.

pkgs.label: STEGO (Stegosaurus v2 in game)
pkgs.fix: From review r1 (pass, 5 minors): (1) t_stego _stretch samples every frame (or every 1/30 s) with GROW_MAX 0.30 m and a comment naming the death@1.53 s neck-crease value (0.269 m); (2) conform_to_ground only conforms while the body is on a terrain floor (or clamps the lift), so a pen foundation or the harbour deck never pulls the model down; (3) correct the report: the v2 thagomizer has about 7 spikes, not 4 (an asset follow-up, STEGO-ART, owns the fix); (4) if W2-RAGDOLL is already on claude/mmo-overhaul when you sync, apply its re-tune list from the report (drop allow_stegosaurus_rig, repoint t_ragdoll._test_placeholder_body at a species with no GLB, rerun its gates); otherwise leave the list for W2-RAGDOLL's integrator. Rerun t_stego, stego_lab (both islands, 3 configs) and every t_*.gd.

pkgs.label: CHARCREATE (Durango character creation)
pkgs.fix: From review r1 (pass, 5 minors; blind A/B 4-0): (1) at 844x390 the Portrait tab's 'Background Color' caption clips in its 86 px column: wrap it to two lines ('Background' / 'Color') or fit the font to the column on compact layouts; (2) after any selection call the occupation list's ensure_control_visible on the selected row so a preselected row is never below the fold on a phone; (3) cc_name_step.name_error: require at least one letter or digit, so '-.-' or '.' are refused (test it); (4) left-align the unreadable-save warning with the story and tighten its line spacing. If DOMAIN is already on claude/mmo-overhaul when you sync, switch DOMAIN's PlayerPortrait to PortraitService.of_player() so there is one portrait source. Re-shoot steps 1-3 at 1600x900 and 844x390 and look at them.

pkgs.label: TARGETUI (tap selects, red swords start combat)
pkgs.fix: From review r3 (pass, 4 minors; blind A/B 12-0): (1) target_swords_hex._spot(): add a ~24 px soft-taken rect around every other on-screen wild creature's screen middle so the hex never sits on a neighbour in a herd (test: 5 animals 1.6 m apart at 844x390, tapping a neighbour selects it); (2) _shown_for() returns null while a sheet is open (hud.sheet_open()), the Animals screen is visible or player.ui is visible, so E and SIC fall through while a screen covers the world (test it); (3) clear the selection once its swords have been hidden for ~3 s or the survivor is beyond ATTACK_SEEK_RANGE, and on phones show the quest card whenever only a selection (not a fight) holds the centre band; (4) keep the swords hex off the survivor's own figure rect. Re-shoot the herd, bag/Animals-open and phone cases and look at them.

pkgs.label: PETRADIAL (pet ring menu: Ride, Feed, Bag, Dismiss, Rename)
pkgs.after: TARGETUI merged (both hook player input and the HUD)
pkgs.fix: From review r1 (pass, 4 minors; blind A/B 7-0): (1) at 844x390 keep the pet visible in the ring's see-through centre (re-anchor on the pet within the safe area, or shrink the radius on compact layouts) and make the ring's disc translucent during a fight so combatants stay visible; (2) the species line shrinks like the title so 'Tyrannosaurus' fits; (3) the bottom tag never touches the XP caption (keep-out rect); (4) online Rename shows a clear 'Rename needs the server' note (or is disabled online) instead of closing as if it worked, until a server handler exists; (5) hide or push world nameplates, damage numbers and health bars that would touch the ring while it is open; (6) Dismiss asks for a one-tap confirm; (7) label the yellow inner arc or remove it. Re-shoot fight, mounted, compsognathus (no Ride) and resize cases at 1600x900 and 844x390 and look at them.
